name: User sentiment
description: User sentiment measures the emotional tone (positive, negative, or neutral) expressed by users in chat conversations, reflecting their satisfaction, frustration, or engagement levels.

name: Customer Pain Point
description: Main problem the customer is trying to solve

name: Purchase intent
description: The likelihood of a user making a transaction, inferred from chat cues like pricing questions, product comparisons, or explicit buying language ("ready to buy," "checkout").
